title: Make the saved-value editor's click-away WebKit check a tools/webkit-verify.mjs probe
evidence: From H40 (PR 1691 and the ValueCell union PR). The click-away checks ran only as a local script on the Mac against the Pages dev server: click away and back within 150 ms, type, wait 2 s (the editor stays open, nothing saved; Enter saves); hide the tab within the click-away delay, then leave (the save is kept); hide after a click away and back (nothing saved). Once both PRs are live, add them to tools/webkit-verify.mjs as a probe with synthetic data, advisory first like the focus-ring probe (H90). (H91)
